en-US.scan_input: Text, prompt, or code to scan
en-US.capabilities_title: Capabilities & What AI FBI Can Do
en-US.capability_monitor: Monitor running processes and AI/script activity indicators in real time (desktop APIs permitting).
en-US.capability_files: Detect exposed secrets and watch configured sensitive files and folders.
en-US.capability_scanner: Scan pasted text, prompts, code, individual files, or folders on demand.
en-US.capability_network: Report new outbound connections as network/exfiltration indicators; this does not change the system firewall.
en-US.capability_quarantine: Quarantine files and let you inspect, restore, or permanently delete them.
en-US.capability_logs: Keep local structured audit logs for scans, alerts, and user actions.
en-US.capability_reports: Export branded JSON/HTML audit reports; Pro also adds custom rules and scheduled scans.
en-US.capability_self: Check selected local policy/config integrity at startup as best-effort self-protection.
en-US.about_disclaimer: AI FBI uses local heuristics. It is not a certified antivirus, cannot guarantee detection, and does not provide kernel-level or firewall blocking.
en-US.desktop_only: Desktop process, network, and file monitoring requires optional platform APIs.

en-US.rule_command_shell_download_execute: Remote content piped to a shell

en-US.scan_warning: Review this heuristic result before taking action.

en-US.drop_invalid: Drop a file or folder to scan it.

en-US.activation_failed: Activation failed. Check the key and try again.

en-US.scheduled_scan_help: Runs while AI FBI is open; scans do not execute files.
